overview: Shared interactive prompt library used by all himosoft-* packages. You rarely install this directly — APT pulls it in as a dependency.
prerequisites: Debian or Ubuntu server with this mirror configured

steps.title: Install (automatic)
steps.body: Installed automatically when you install any other Himosoft package.

notes: Provides /usr/share/himosoft/lib/interactive.sh — banners, confirmations, and secure prompts.
No configuration or setup command is required.
